aws.claude_a.iam.role_trust_not_public.description: Flags an IAM role whose AssumeRolePolicyDocument has an Allow statement with a wildcard principal ("*" or AWS "*") that is not narrowed by a StringEquals/StringLike (no '*') or ARN condition on aws:SourceOwner, aws:SourceAccount, aws:PrincipalOrgID, aws:PrincipalAccount, aws:PrincipalArn or aws:SourceArn. Such a trust policy lets any AWS account call sts:AssumeRole and obtain the role's permissions.
aws.claude_a.iam.role_trust_not_public.pass_when: No Allow statement in the trust policy has an unrestricted wildcard principal.
aws.claude_a.iam.role_trust_not_public.fail_when: At least one Allow trust statement names a wildcard principal without one of the recognised account/organization/ARN restricting condition keys.

aws.claude_a.iam.role_used_within_60_day.description: Flags an IAM role that has no RoleLastUsed.LastUsedDate or whose last use is at or before the cutoff of 60 days before the collection midnight. Dormant roles keep their permissions and trust relationships and are a quiet persistence or takeover target nobody is watching.
aws.claude_a.iam.role_used_within_60_day.pass_when: RoleLastUsed.LastUsedDate is later than the 60-day cutoff.
aws.claude_a.iam.role_used_within_60_day.fail_when: RoleLastUsed.LastUsedDate is absent (never used or not tracked) or is on/before the 60-day cutoff.

aws.claude_a.iam.root_console_has_mfa.description: Uses the IAM account summary to flag an account whose root user has a console password (AccountPasswordPresent = 1) while AccountMFAEnabled = 0. A root password without MFA means one phished or reused password gives unrestricted control of the whole account.
aws.claude_a.iam.root_console_has_mfa.pass_when: The root user has no password, or AccountMFAEnabled is 1.

aws.claude_a.iam.root_credentials_manage.description: For an account that belongs to AWS Organizations, flags the organization when IAM's EnabledFeatures does not contain RootCredentialsManagement (centralized root access). Without it every member account keeps its own long-lived root credentials that have to be secured individually.
aws.claude_a.iam.root_credentials_manage.fail_when: The account is in an organization (OrganizationId starts with o-) and EnabledFeatures lacks RootCredentialsManagement.
aws.claude_a.iam.root_credentials_manage.not_applicable_when: The account configuration shows the account is not a member of an organization.

aws.claude_a.iam.saml_provider_present.description: Account-level check that fails when the IAM SAML provider inventory is empty, i.e. no identity federation through a SAML IdP is configured. Without federation, human access tends to rely on long-lived IAM users and passwords instead of centrally managed SSO identities.
aws.claude_a.iam.saml_provider_present.pass_when: At least one IAM SAML provider exists.
aws.claude_a.iam.saml_provider_present.fail_when: No IAM SAML provider is returned for the account.

aws.claude_a.iam.securityaudit_role_exis.description: Account-level check that fails when no IAM role has the AWS managed SecurityAudit policy attached. Without a dedicated read-only audit role, security reviews end up using over-privileged identities or cannot be performed consistently.
aws.claude_a.iam.securityaudit_role_exis.pass_when: At least one IAM role has the SecurityAudit managed policy attached.
aws.claude_a.iam.securityaudit_role_exis.fail_when: No collected IAM role has the SecurityAudit managed policy attached.

aws.claude_a.iam.server_certificate_not_.description: Flags an IAM server certificate whose Expiration timestamp is at or before the current time. Expired certificates still attached to load balancers or CloudFront break TLS for clients and invite users to click through certificate warnings.
aws.claude_a.iam.server_certificate_not_.fail_when: Expiration is now or in the past.

aws.claude_a.iam.support_role_exists.description: Account-level Prowler check that fails when no IAM role has the AWSSupportAccess managed policy attached. Without a support role, incident handling with AWS Support has to be done by root or by broadly privileged users.
aws.claude_a.iam.support_role_exists.pass_when: At least one IAM role has the AWSSupportAccess managed policy attached.
aws.claude_a.iam.support_role_exists.fail_when: No collected IAM role has the AWSSupportAccess managed policy attached.

aws.claude_a.iam.user_bedrock_access_not.description: Looks at an IAM user's service-last-accessed data for the bedrock namespace and fails when the entry was never authenticated or was last used more than 60 days ago (Prowler logic). Unused Bedrock permissions widen what a stolen user credential can do (model invocation cost, data in prompts) for no business benefit.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_bedrock_access_not.pass_when: The bedrock entry has a LastAuthenticated date at most 60 days old.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_bedrock_access_not.fail_when: The bedrock entry has no LastAuthenticated value or (now - LastAuthenticated).days is greater than 60.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_bedrock_access_not.not_applicable_when: ServicesLastAccessed contains no bedrock namespace entry (the user has no Bedrock permissions).

aws.claude_a.iam.user_in_group.description: Flags an IAM user whose GroupList is empty, meaning its permissions come only from directly attached or inline policies. Per-user grants are hard to review and drift easily, so access is not managed through role-based groups.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_in_group.pass_when: GroupList contains at least one group.

aws.claude_a.iam.user_inline_kms_decrypt.description: Inspects the inline policies of an IAM user and fails when an Allow statement grants *, kms:*, kms:decrypt, kms:deencrypt* or kms:reencryptfrom on Resource *, arn:aws:kms:*:<account>:key/* or arn:aws:kms:*:<account>:alias/*. Broad decrypt rights let the user read any data protected by any key in the account.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_inline_kms_decrypt.pass_when: No inline Allow statement pairs a listed decrypt-class action with an all-keys resource.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_inline_kms_decrypt.fail_when: At least one inline Allow statement grants a listed decrypt-class action on * or on all keys/aliases of the account.

aws.claude_a.iam.user_inline_no_admin.description: Fails when any inline policy of an IAM user contains an Allow statement with Action * (or *:*) on Resource *. Such a user is a full administrator through a policy that is not visible in the managed-policy inventory.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_inline_no_admin.pass_when: No inline Allow statement combines Action */*:* with Resource *.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_inline_no_admin.fail_when: At least one inline Allow statement grants */*:* on Resource *.

aws.claude_a.iam.user_inline_no_assume_r.description: Serializes each inline policy of an IAM user (PolicyName plus PolicyDocument as JSON) and fails when the text contains the case-sensitive substring AssumeRole. Users that can assume roles directly (sts:AssumeRole, AssumeRoleWithSAML, ...) can pivot into other roles or accounts outside group-managed access.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_inline_no_assume_r.pass_when: No inline policy name or document text contains AssumeRole.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_inline_no_assume_r.fail_when: An inline policy's serialized name/document contains AssumeRole anywhere (Allow or Deny statement, or even the policy name).

aws.claude_a.iam.user_inline_no_blocked_.description: Fails when an inline policy of an IAM user has an Allow statement whose action is exactly one of kms:decrypt, kms:decrypt*, kms:reencryptfrom, kms:* or kms:reencrypt* (on any resource). These actions let the user decrypt or re-encrypt data under KMS keys outside of key-policy review.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_inline_no_blocked_.pass_when: No inline Allow statement lists one of the blocked KMS actions.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_inline_no_blocked_.fail_when: At least one inline Allow statement lists a blocked KMS action.

aws.claude_a.iam.user_long_lived_keys_on.description: Fails for an IAM user that has access keys and whose service-last-accessed list contains any namespace other than iam or sts (Prowler). Using long-lived keys for workloads instead of temporary role credentials leaves non-expiring secrets that work against many services if leaked.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_long_lived_keys_on.pass_when: The user has no access keys, or every listed namespace is iam or sts.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_long_lived_keys_on.fail_when: The user has at least one access key and ServicesLastAccessed lists a namespace other than iam/sts.

aws.claude_a.iam.user_no_cloudshell_full.description: Fails when an IAM user has the AWS managed policy arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSCloudShellFullAccess attached (commercial-partition ARN only). CloudShell full access gives a browser shell with file upload/download, a convenient exfiltration path for the user's credentials and data.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_no_cloudshell_full.pass_when: AWSCloudShellFullAccess is not attached to the user.

aws.claude_a.iam.user_no_inline_policies.description: Fails when an IAM user has one or more inline policies. Inline grants are embedded in the user, are not reusable or centrally reviewed, and are easy to overlook when auditing who has which permissions.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_no_inline_policies.fail_when: UserPolicyList contains at least one inline policy.

aws.claude_a.iam.user_one_active_key.description: Counts the access keys of an IAM user with Status Active and fails when there are more than one. Two active keys usually means a rotation was never finished, doubling the number of live long-lived secrets.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_one_active_key.pass_when: Exactly one access key is Active.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_one_active_key.fail_when: Two or more access keys are Active.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_one_active_key.not_applicable_when: The user has no Active access key.

aws.claude_a.iam.user_sagemaker_access_n.description: Looks at an IAM user's service-last-accessed data for the sagemaker namespace and fails when the entry was never authenticated or was last used more than 90 days ago (Prowler logic). Idle SageMaker permissions can be abused to launch notebooks or training jobs that pass privileged roles.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_sagemaker_access_n.pass_when: The sagemaker entry has a LastAuthenticated date at most 90 days old.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_sagemaker_access_n.fail_when: The sagemaker entry has no LastAuthenticated value or (now - LastAuthenticated).days is greater than 90.
aws.claude_a.iam.user_sagemaker_access_n.not_applicable_when: ServicesLastAccessed contains no sagemaker namespace entry.

aws.claude_a.kms.customer_key_enabled_or.description: For customer managed KMS keys, fails when KeyMetadata.Enabled is false and KeyState is not PendingDeletion (Steampipe kms_cmk_unused). Disabled keys that are never scheduled for deletion are forgotten key material that still costs money and can be re-enabled by anyone with kms:EnableKey.
aws.claude_a.kms.customer_key_enabled_or.pass_when: The key is Enabled, or it is disabled but in PendingDeletion.
aws.claude_a.kms.customer_key_enabled_or.fail_when: Enabled is false and KeyState is anything other than PendingDeletion.

aws.claude_a.kms.customer_key_not_pendin.description: Fails for a customer managed KMS key whose KeyState is PendingDeletion. Once the waiting period ends the key is destroyed and every ciphertext encrypted under it becomes permanently unrecoverable.
aws.claude_a.kms.customer_key_not_pendin.pass_when: KeyState is any value other than PendingDeletion (Disabled included).

aws.claude_a.kms.key_policy_not_public.description: For customer managed keys, fails when the key policy has an Allow statement with a wildcard principal that is not restricted by kms:CallerAccount or by aws:SourceOwner/SourceAccount/PrincipalOrgID/PrincipalAccount/PrincipalArn/SourceArn conditions without wildcards (StringLike/ArnEquals/ArnLike with '*' do not count). A public key policy lets any AWS principal use or administer the key.
aws.claude_a.kms.key_policy_not_public.pass_when: No Allow statement has an unrestricted wildcard principal.
aws.claude_a.kms.key_policy_not_public.fail_when: At least one Allow statement has a wildcard principal without a recognised restricting condition.

aws.claude_a.kms.prowler_cmk_rotation.description: For enabled customer managed keys whose CustomerMasterKeySpec contains SYMMETRIC, fails when Rotation.KeyRotationEnabled is false, and always fails when the key Origin is EXTERNAL (Prowler). Without rotation the same key material protects data indefinitely, enlarging the impact of a key compromise.
aws.claude_a.kms.prowler_cmk_rotation.pass_when: The enabled symmetric customer key is not EXTERNAL-origin and KeyRotationEnabled is true.
aws.claude_a.kms.prowler_cmk_rotation.fail_when: KeyRotationEnabled is false, or the key Origin contains EXTERNAL (imported key material).
aws.claude_a.kms.prowler_cmk_rotation.not_applicable_when: The key is AWS managed, not in Enabled state, or not a SYMMETRIC key spec.

aws.claude_a.kms.prowler_cmk_single_regi.description: For enabled customer managed keys, fails when KeyMetadata.MultiRegion is true (Prowler). Multi-Region keys share the same key material across Regions, so a policy mistake or compromise in one replica Region exposes data everywhere.
aws.claude_a.kms.prowler_cmk_single_regi.not_applicable_when: The key is AWS managed or its KeyState is not Enabled.

aws.claude_a.kms.prowler_cmk_used.description: For customer managed keys, fails when KeyState is neither Enabled nor PendingDeletion, e.g. Disabled or PendingImport (Prowler kms_cmk_are_used). Keys left in an unused state are dead configuration that obscures the real key inventory and can be re-enabled silently.
aws.claude_a.kms.prowler_cmk_used.fail_when: KeyState is any other value (Disabled, PendingImport, Unavailable, ...).

aws.claude_a.kms.prowler_key_not_public.description: For enabled customer managed keys, applies Prowler's is_policy_public to the key policy against the audited account and fails when a statement allows a public or other-account principal without a restricting condition. Anyone matched by such a statement can encrypt/decrypt or manage the key.
aws.claude_a.kms.prowler_key_not_public.pass_when: is_policy_public reports no public statement in the key policy.
aws.claude_a.kms.prowler_key_not_public.fail_when: is_policy_public reports at least one public statement in the key policy.
aws.claude_a.kms.prowler_key_not_public.not_applicable_when: The key is AWS managed or its KeyState is not Enabled.

aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.deletion_pr.description: Fails when an AWS Network Firewall has DeleteProtection set to false. Without it a single DeleteFirewall call (by mistake or by an attacker) removes inspection and filtering for the protected VPC.

aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.firewall_fr.description: For each firewall, resolves its associated firewall policy and fails when StatelessFragmentDefaultActions has neither aws:drop nor aws:forward_to_sfe. The firewall would pass fragmented packets that match no stateless rule, allowing fragmentation-based evasion.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.firewall_fr.pass_when: The associated policy's StatelessFragmentDefaultActions includes aws:drop or aws:forward_to_sfe.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.firewall_fr.fail_when: The associated policy's StatelessFragmentDefaultActions (missing treated as empty) has neither aws:drop nor aws:forward_to_sfe.

aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.firewall_fu.description: For each firewall, joins its FirewallPolicyArn to the collected firewall policy and fails when that policy's StatelessDefaultActions has neither aws:drop nor aws:forward_to_sfe (Prowler per-firewall view). The firewall would forward unmatched full packets without stateful inspection.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.firewall_fu.pass_when: The associated policy's StatelessDefaultActions includes aws:drop or aws:forward_to_sfe.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.firewall_fu.fail_when: The associated policy's StatelessDefaultActions (missing treated as empty) has neither aws:drop nor aws:forward_to_sfe.

aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.firewall_po.description: For each firewall, resolves the associated firewall policy and fails when that policy references no stateful and no stateless rule group (Prowler). The firewall is deployed but enforces nothing beyond its default actions.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.firewall_po.pass_when: The associated policy references at least one rule group.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.firewall_po.fail_when: The associated policy references no rule groups.

aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.in_use_vpc_.description: For a VPC that has network interfaces (is in use), fails when no collected Network Firewall has that VpcId (Prowler). Active VPCs without a network firewall have no managed stateful inspection of their ingress/egress traffic.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.in_use_vpc_.pass_when: A Network Firewall is deployed in the VPC.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.in_use_vpc_.fail_when: The VPC is in use and no Network Firewall references its VpcId.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.in_use_vpc_.not_applicable_when: No network interface in the inventory belongs to the VPC (VPC not in use).

aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.in_vpc.description: Checks documented Network Firewall placement: classic VPC and proxy endpoint VPC associations satisfy the VPC criterion; transit-gateway attachment is a separate supported mode. Placement does not prove traffic inspection.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.in_vpc.pass_when: A valid classic VpcId with subnet mappings or proxy VpcEndpoint VpcId with subnet mappings is observed.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.in_vpc.fail_when: No documented valid placement shape produces a definite FAIL; missing, malformed or conflicting facts are UNKNOWN.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.in_vpc.not_applicable_when: A valid transit-gateway-attached firewall with AvailabilityZoneMappings is outside the VPC-only criterion.

aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.logging.description: Fails when the firewall's LoggingConfiguration has no LogDestinationConfigs (no flow or alert logs sent to S3, CloudWatch Logs or Firehose). Without firewall logs, blocked attacks and allowed suspicious flows leave no evidence for detection or investigation.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.logging.pass_when: At least one log destination is configured.

aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.multi_az.description: Fails when a Network Firewall has one or fewer SubnetMappings, so its endpoints live in a single Availability Zone. An AZ outage then removes the firewall path, either dropping traffic or forcing routing that skips inspection.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.multi_az.pass_when: SubnetMappings contains two or more subnets.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.multi_az.fail_when: SubnetMappings contains at most one subnet.

aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.policy_frag.description: Evaluates a firewall policy and fails when StatelessFragmentDefaultActions contains neither aws:drop nor aws:forward_to_sfe. Passing fragmented packets by default is a classic evasion path because fragments can hide payloads from inspection.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.policy_frag.fail_when: StatelessFragmentDefaultActions includes neither aws:drop nor aws:forward_to_sfe.

aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.policy_full.description: Evaluates a firewall policy and fails when StatelessDefaultActions contains neither aws:drop nor aws:forward_to_sfe. With aws:pass as the default, full packets that match no stateless rule are let through without stateful inspection.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.policy_full.fail_when: StatelessDefaultActions includes neither aws:drop nor aws:forward_to_sfe.

aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.policy_has_.description: Fails when a firewall policy has neither StatefulRuleGroupReferences nor StatelessRuleGroupReferences. A policy with no rule groups only applies default actions and performs no real traffic filtering.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.policy_has_.pass_when: At least one stateful or stateless rule group is referenced.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.policy_has_.fail_when: Both rule-group reference lists are absent or empty.

aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.stateless_r.description: For a STATELESS Network Firewall rule group, fails when RuleGroup.RulesSource.StatelessRulesAndCustomActions contains no StatelessRules. An empty stateless rule group is referenced by policies as if it filtered traffic while it matches nothing.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.stateless_r.pass_when: The stateless rule group contains at least one stateless rule.
aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.stateless_r.fail_when: The stateless rule group contains no stateless rules.

aws.claude_a.networkfirewall.subnet_chan.description: Fails when an AWS Network Firewall has SubnetChangeProtection set to false. Unprotected subnet associations can be changed to move the firewall endpoints, letting traffic bypass inspection.

aws.claude_a.organizations.ai_services_o.description: Account-level Prowler check over AISERVICES_OPT_OUT_POLICY organization policies: passes only if one has services.default.opt_out_policy with @@assign = optOut and @@operators_allowed_for_child_policies = [@@none]. Without it AWS AI services may store and use account content to improve models, and child OUs can override the choice.
aws.claude_a.organizations.ai_services_o.pass_when: An AI services opt-out policy assigns optOut and forbids child-policy overrides.
aws.claude_a.organizations.ai_services_o.fail_when: No AI opt-out policy meets both conditions, or the account is not in an organization (treated as FAIL).

aws.claude_a.organizations.no_untrusted_.description: For an account in an organization, fails when the DelegatedAdministrators listing contains any account (Prowler's trusted list defaults to empty). Every delegated administrator can manage an organization-wide service such as GuardDuty or Security Hub, so each one widens the organization's admin surface.
aws.claude_a.organizations.no_untrusted_.fail_when: One or more delegated administrator accounts are registered.
aws.claude_a.organizations.no_untrusted_.not_applicable_when: The account is not a member of an organization.

aws.claude_a.organizations.scp_restricts.description: Checks for a broad Deny SCP using aws:RequestedRegion with a nonempty approved-region set, Resource:*, no extra AND condition keys, and a direct target-account attachment. Action:* is broad; NotAction may exempt only documented single-endpoint global services (cloudfront, iam, organizations, route53, support, budgets, globalaccelerator, importexport, and waf), each in svc:action form with a nonempty action. Any other NotAction exemption, narrow resource scope, or extra AND key is UNKNOWN. Root or OU attachment without proven ancestry is UNKNOWN; an unattached or Allow-only policy does not pass.
aws.claude_a.organizations.scp_restricts.pass_when: A directly account-attached Deny SCP has Resource:*, only a nonempty aws:RequestedRegion exception condition, and either Action:* without NotAction or a nonempty NotAction containing only svc:action entries for cloudfront, iam, organizations, route53, support, budgets, globalaccelerator, importexport, and waf; each action part is nonempty.
aws.claude_a.organizations.scp_restricts.fail_when: Complete evidence proves there is no qualifying directly effective regional Deny, including no organization membership.

aws.claude_a.organizations.tag_policy_at.description: Account-level Prowler check over TAG_POLICY organization policies: fails when no tag policy has a non-empty Targets list. Without an attached tag policy, tagging used for ownership, cost and ABAC decisions is not enforced across accounts.
aws.claude_a.organizations.tag_policy_at.pass_when: At least one tag policy is attached to a root, OU or account.
aws.claude_a.organizations.tag_policy_at.fail_when: No tag policy has targets, none exists, or the account is not in an organization (treated as FAIL).

aws.claude_a.s3.access_point_public_acce.description: Fails for an S3 access point whose PublicAccessBlockConfiguration does not have all four settings (BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, RestrictPublicBuckets) set to true. An access point without a full block can carry a policy that exposes bucket objects publicly.
aws.claude_a.s3.access_point_public_acce.pass_when: All four public access block settings are true.
aws.claude_a.s3.access_point_public_acce.fail_when: Any of the four settings is false or missing.

aws.claude_a.s3.account_public_access_bl.description: Account-level check that fails unless the account's S3 public access block has BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy and RestrictPublicBuckets all true; an absent configuration counts as all false. Without the account-wide block, any single bucket ACL or policy mistake can make data public.
aws.claude_a.s3.account_public_access_bl.pass_when: All four account-level settings are true.
aws.claude_a.s3.account_public_access_bl.fail_when: Any account-level setting is false, or no account configuration exists.

aws.claude_a.s3.acls_prohibit_user_acces.description: Fails when the bucket ACL grants permissions to canonical user IDs other than the bucket owner, unless Object Ownership is BucketOwnerEnforced (ACLs disabled). ACL grants to other canonical users are an access path outside IAM and bucket policy that is easy to miss in reviews.
aws.claude_a.s3.acls_prohibit_user_acces.pass_when: ObjectOwnership is BucketOwnerEnforced, or every grantee ID equals the owner ID.
aws.claude_a.s3.acls_prohibit_user_acces.fail_when: ACLs are enabled and a grant names a canonical user ID other than the owner.
aws.claude_a.s3.acls_prohibit_user_acces.not_applicable_when: The ACL contains no grantee with a canonical user ID.

aws.claude_a.s3.bucket_public_access_blo.description: Fails for a bucket whose own PublicAccessBlock does not have all four settings true; the account-level block is not considered. A bucket relying solely on the account block becomes exposable as soon as the account setting is relaxed.
aws.claude_a.s3.bucket_public_access_blo.pass_when: All four bucket-level settings are true.
aws.claude_a.s3.bucket_public_access_blo.fail_when: Any bucket-level setting is false or the bucket has no public access block configuration.

aws.claude_a.s3.default_encryption_kms_k.description: Fails when no bucket server-side encryption rule sets ApplyServerSideEncryptionByDefault.KMSMasterKeyID. Without a designated KMS key, objects default to SSE-S3 where access to the data cannot be separately controlled or audited through a key policy.
aws.claude_a.s3.default_encryption_kms_k.pass_when: At least one encryption rule specifies a KMSMasterKeyID.
aws.claude_a.s3.default_encryption_kms_k.fail_when: No encryption rule specifies a KMSMasterKeyID (including no encryption configuration).

aws.claude_a.s3.directory_bucket_lifecyc.description: Fails for an S3 directory bucket (Express One Zone) that has no lifecycle configuration. Directory buckets hold high-cost single-AZ data; without expiry rules temporary data and incomplete uploads persist and keep being exposed.
aws.claude_a.s3.directory_bucket_lifecyc.pass_when: A lifecycle configuration exists for the directory bucket.

aws.claude_a.s3.event_notifications.description: Checks whether a collected S3 notification configuration has a nonempty Topic, Queue, or Lambda destination array, or a present EventBridgeConfiguration (including an empty object). Empty destination arrays alone fail; missing or denied detail is UNKNOWN.
aws.claude_a.s3.event_notifications.pass_when: At least one destination array is nonempty or EventBridgeConfiguration is present.
aws.claude_a.s3.event_notifications.fail_when: All three destination arrays are absent or empty and EventBridgeConfiguration is absent.

aws.claude_a.s3.lifecycle_rule_enabled.description: Fails when the bucket has no lifecycle rule with Status Enabled. Without lifecycle management, stale objects and old versions accumulate indefinitely, growing cost and the volume of data exposed in a breach.
aws.claude_a.s3.lifecycle_rule_enabled.pass_when: At least one lifecycle rule is Enabled.
aws.claude_a.s3.lifecycle_rule_enabled.fail_when: No lifecycle configuration exists or all rules are Disabled.

aws.claude_a.s3.multi_region_access_poin.description: Fails for an S3 Multi-Region Access Point whose PublicAccessBlock does not have all four settings true. A Multi-Region Access Point fronts buckets in several Regions, so a missing block can expose all of them through one public endpoint.
aws.claude_a.s3.multi_region_access_poin.pass_when: All four public access block settings are true.
aws.claude_a.s3.multi_region_access_poin.fail_when: Any of the four settings is false or missing.

aws.claude_a.s3.no_authenticated_users_a.description: Fails when the bucket ACL contains a grant to the global AuthenticatedUsers group (http://acs.amazonaws.com/groups/global/AuthenticatedUsers). That group means any AWS account holder anywhere, so the grant is effectively public access.
aws.claude_a.s3.no_authenticated_users_a.pass_when: No grant targets the AuthenticatedUsers group.
aws.claude_a.s3.no_authenticated_users_a.fail_when: At least one grant targets the AuthenticatedUsers group.

aws.claude_a.s3.object_level_logging.description: Fails when no CloudTrail trail that can see the bucket logs S3 object data events for it: an event selector DataResources value equal to the bucket ARN, an all-buckets arn:<partition>:s3 value, or any advanced selector on AWS::S3::Object (multi-Region trails or trails homed in the bucket Region). Without object-level logging, GetObject/PutObject/DeleteObject activity leaves no audit trail for exfiltration or tampering investigations.
aws.claude_a.s3.object_level_logging.pass_when: A relevant trail's S3 data selector names this bucket ARN, all buckets, or an advanced AWS::S3::Object selector.
aws.claude_a.s3.object_level_logging.fail_when: No multi-Region or same-Region trail has an S3 data selector covering the bucket.

aws.claude_a.s3.object_lock_configured.description: Fails when the bucket has no Object Lock configuration (GetObjectLockConfiguration returns none). Without Object Lock, objects can be deleted or overwritten by anyone with write access, so backups and logs are not protected as WORM data.

aws.claude_a.s3.perimeter_policy_not_pub.description: aws-perimeter variant: fails when an Allow bucket-policy statement has a wildcard principal not restricted by aws:SourceOwner/SourceAccount/PrincipalOrgID/PrincipalAccount/PrincipalArn/SourceArn, where StringLike/ArnEquals/ArnLike values containing '*' do not count as restricting. This catches policies that look conditioned but still admit any account.
aws.claude_a.s3.perimeter_policy_not_pub.pass_when: No Allow statement has an unrestricted wildcard principal.
aws.claude_a.s3.perimeter_policy_not_pub.fail_when: At least one Allow statement has a wildcard principal whose conditions do not restrict it to specific accounts/ARNs.
aws.claude_a.s3.perimeter_policy_not_pub.not_applicable_when: The bucket has no bucket policy.

aws.claude_a.s3.policy_no_cross_account_.description: Fails when the bucket policy has an Allow statement whose AWS principal is * or an ARN from another account and whose actions include exactly s3:DeleteBucketPolicy, s3:PutBucketAcl, s3:PutBucketPolicy, s3:PutEncryptionConfiguration or s3:PutObjectAcl (wildcards such as s3:* are not matched). Another account able to rewrite the bucket's policy or ACL can take control of the data.
aws.claude_a.s3.policy_no_cross_account_.pass_when: No Allow statement grants one of the five permission-change actions to * or another account (no policy also passes).
aws.claude_a.s3.policy_no_cross_account_.fail_when: An Allow statement grants one of the five actions to * or to a principal ARN of a different account.

aws.claude_a.s3.policy_restrict_public_a.description: Fails when the bucket policy has an Allow statement with a wildcard in the first present of Principal AWS/CanonicalUser/Federated (or Principal "*") and no restricting condition key (aws:PrincipalOrgID, SourceAccount, PrincipalAccount, SourceOwner with string-equals operators, aws:PrincipalArn or aws:SourceArn with ARN operators). Such a statement grants its actions to anyone.
aws.claude_a.s3.policy_restrict_public_a.pass_when: Every wildcard-principal Allow statement carries one of the restricting operator/key pairs.
aws.claude_a.s3.policy_restrict_public_a.fail_when: At least one wildcard-principal Allow statement has no restricting condition.
aws.claude_a.s3.policy_restrict_public_a.not_applicable_when: The bucket has no bucket policy.

aws.claude_a.s3.protected_by_macie.description: Fails when no Amazon Macie classification job in the bucket's Region lists this bucket by name in s3JobDefinition.bucketDefinitions[].buckets. Buckets not scanned by Macie may hold sensitive data (PII, credentials) that nobody knows about or monitors.
aws.claude_a.s3.protected_by_macie.pass_when: A Macie job in the bucket's Region explicitly includes the bucket.
aws.claude_a.s3.protected_by_macie.fail_when: Macie is enabled in the bucket Region and no job lists the bucket (criteria-based jobs make the result UNKNOWN instead).
aws.claude_a.s3.protected_by_macie.not_applicable_when: The bucket is in GovCloud, or Macie is not enabled in the bucket's Region.

aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_account_ignore_r.description: Account-level Prowler check that fails when the account public access block does not have both IgnorePublicAcls and RestrictPublicBuckets true. These two settings neutralise existing public ACLs and public policies on every bucket in the account.
aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_account_ignore_r.pass_when: IgnorePublicAcls and RestrictPublicBuckets are both true at account level.
aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_account_ignore_r.fail_when: Either IgnorePublicAcls or RestrictPublicBuckets is false or absent at account level.
aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_account_ignore_r.not_applicable_when: The account has no S3 buckets.

aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_acl_disabled.description: Fails when the first OwnershipControls rule's ObjectOwnership does not contain BucketOwnerEnforced, or when no ownership controls exist (Prowler). With ACLs enabled, object writers can retain ownership and grant access through ACLs that bypass the bucket policy.
aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_acl_disabled.fail_when: ObjectOwnership is BucketOwnerPreferred/ObjectWriter or the OwnershipControls configuration is absent.

aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_bucket_level_pub.description: Fails for a bucket unless IgnorePublicAcls and RestrictPublicBuckets are both true either on the bucket's own block or on the account block (Prowler). Without them any public ACL or public bucket policy on the bucket takes effect.
aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_bucket_level_pub.pass_when: The bucket or the account has both IgnorePublicAcls and RestrictPublicBuckets true.
aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_bucket_level_pub.fail_when: Neither the bucket nor the account has both settings true.

aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_cross_account_po.description: Applies Prowler's is_policy_public with cross-account access disallowed, so any Allow to a principal outside the audited account (or public) fails. Cross-account bucket access is a data-sharing path that must be explicitly reviewed and trusted.
aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_cross_account_po.pass_when: The bucket has no policy, or no statement allows a principal outside the audited account.
aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_cross_account_po.fail_when: A statement allows a public or other-account principal without a restricting condition.

aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_cross_region_rep.description: Fails unless the bucket is versioned and has an Enabled replication rule whose destination bucket is in a different Region (Prowler). Same-Region or missing replication leaves no copy that survives a Regional outage or Region-scoped compromise.
aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_cross_region_rep.pass_when: Versioning is Enabled and an Enabled rule replicates to a bucket in another Region.
aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_cross_region_rep.fail_when: Versioning is off, there is no Enabled rule, or every destination is in the same Region.

aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_kms_encryption.description: Fails when the first default-encryption rule's SSEAlgorithm is not aws:kms or aws:kms:dsse, or when the bucket has no encryption configuration (Prowler). SSE-S3 alone gives no key-policy based access control and no per-key CloudTrail record of decrypts.
aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_kms_encryption.pass_when: Rules[0] SSEAlgorithm is aws:kms or aws:kms:dsse.
aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_kms_encryption.fail_when: Rules[0] SSEAlgorithm is AES256 or another value, or the encryption configuration is absent.

aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_policy_public_wr.description: Fails when the bucket policy is public for s3:PutObject, s3:DeleteObject, s3:*, s3:Put* or s3:Delete* (is_policy_public with those actions) and RestrictPublicBuckets is false at both bucket and account level. Public write lets anyone plant malware, overwrite or delete the bucket's objects.
aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_policy_public_wr.pass_when: No policy, RestrictPublicBuckets on bucket or account, or no public write statement.
aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_policy_public_wr.fail_when: A public statement grants a write/delete action and RestrictPublicBuckets is off at bucket and account level.

aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_public_access.description: Prowler public-bucket check: passes when the bucket's own block has IgnorePublicAcls and RestrictPublicBuckets; otherwise fails if the ACL grants anything to AllUsers/AuthenticatedUsers or the bucket policy is public (is_policy_public), unless the account block has both settings. A public bucket exposes its objects to anyone on the internet.
aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_public_access.pass_when: The bucket or account blocks public ACLs and policies, or there is no public group grant and no public policy.
aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_public_access.fail_when: A public group grant or public policy exists and neither the bucket nor the account has both IgnorePublicAcls and RestrictPublicBuckets.

aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_public_list_acl.description: Fails when the bucket ACL grants FULL_CONTROL, READ or READ_ACP to the AllUsers or AuthenticatedUsers group and neither the bucket nor the account has both IgnorePublicAcls and RestrictPublicBuckets. Such a grant lets anyone list the bucket's objects or read its ACL.
aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_public_list_acl.pass_when: No public group grant has FULL_CONTROL/READ/READ_ACP, or public ACLs are neutralised at bucket or account level.
aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_public_list_acl.fail_when: A public group grant with FULL_CONTROL/READ/READ_ACP is effective.

aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_public_write_acl.description: Fails when the bucket ACL grants FULL_CONTROL, WRITE or WRITE_ACP to AllUsers or AuthenticatedUsers and neither the bucket nor the account has both IgnorePublicAcls and RestrictPublicBuckets. Public write lets anyone upload, overwrite or delete objects and change the ACL.
aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_public_write_acl.pass_when: No public group grant has FULL_CONTROL/WRITE/WRITE_ACP, or public ACLs are neutralised at bucket or account level.
aws.claude_a.s3.prowler_public_write_acl.fail_when: A public group grant with FULL_CONTROL/WRITE/WRITE_ACP is effective.

aws.claude_a.s3.replication_rule_enabled.description: Fails when the bucket's ReplicationConfiguration has no rule with Status Enabled (no configuration counts as no rules). Without replication there is no second copy to recover from Regional loss, accidental deletion or ransomware-style overwrites.
aws.claude_a.s3.replication_rule_enabled.pass_when: At least one replication rule has Status Enabled.
aws.claude_a.s3.replication_rule_enabled.fail_when: No replication configuration exists or every rule is Disabled.

aws.claude_a.s3.restrict_public_read.description: Steampipe public-read check: fails when an AllUsers/AuthenticatedUsers grant with FULL_CONTROL, READ_ACP or READ exists without BlockPublicAcls, or when GetBucketPolicyStatus reports IsPublic, BlockPublicPolicy is off and an Allow Principal * statement grants *, *:*, s3:*, s3:get* or s3:list*. Public read exposes bucket contents to the internet.
aws.claude_a.s3.restrict_public_read.pass_when: Public read ACL grants are blocked or absent, and the policy is not public, is blocked, or has no wildcard read statement.
aws.claude_a.s3.restrict_public_read.fail_when: An unblocked public read ACL grant exists, or a public policy with a wildcard-principal read statement is not blocked by BlockPublicPolicy.

aws.claude_a.s3.static_website_disabled.description: Fails when the bucket has a website configuration with IndexDocument.Suffix set (static website hosting enabled). Website endpoints serve objects over plain HTTP without IAM authentication and are a common source of unintended public exposure.
aws.claude_a.s3.static_website_disabled.pass_when: No website configuration (or no index document suffix) is present.

aws.claude_a.s3.versioning_and_lifecycle.description: Applies the lifecycle criterion only to buckets with Versioning.Status=Enabled. A version-enabled bucket without an enabled lifecycle rule fails; complete unversioned or suspended buckets are NOT_APPLICABLE and separate versioning checks cover them.
aws.claude_a.s3.versioning_and_lifecycle.pass_when: Versioning is Enabled and at least one lifecycle rule is Enabled.
aws.claude_a.s3.versioning_and_lifecycle.fail_when: Versioning is Enabled and no lifecycle rule is Enabled.
aws.claude_a.s3.versioning_and_lifecycle.not_applicable_when: Versioning is not Enabled, including suspended or unversioned buckets.

aws.claude_a.securityhub.enabled_with_st.description: Regional check that fails when Security Hub has no hub, or when a hub has no enabled standards and no product subscriptions other than AWS's own securityhub product. An enabled but empty hub collects no findings, so posture issues are not aggregated or alerted.
aws.claude_a.securityhub.enabled_with_st.pass_when: Every hub has at least one enabled standard or a non-securityhub product integration.
aws.claude_a.securityhub.enabled_with_st.fail_when: No hub exists in the Region, or a hub has zero standards and zero third-party/other integrations.

aws.claude_a.securityhub.prowler_delegat.description: Regional Prowler check that fails when Security Hub is not enabled, when no organization admin account has Status ENABLED, or when a hub's OrganizationConfiguration.AutoEnable is false. Without a delegated administrator and auto-enable, new member accounts are not brought under central Security Hub coverage.
aws.claude_a.securityhub.prowler_delegat.pass_when: A hub exists, an ENABLED delegated admin is configured and AutoEnable is true on every hub.
aws.claude_a.securityhub.prowler_delegat.fail_when: No hub, no ENABLED delegated admin, or AutoEnable is false.

aws.claude_a.vpc.block_public_access_igw.description: Flags the regional VPC Block Public Access configuration when VpcBlockPublicAccessOptions.InternetGatewayBlockMode is neither block-bidirectional nor block-ingress. Internet gateway traffic can reach VPCs without an account-level block.
aws.claude_a.vpc.block_public_access_igw.pass_when: PASS when VpcBlockPublicAccessOptions.InternetGatewayBlockMode is neither block-bidirectional nor block-ingress is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.block_public_access_igw.fail_when: FAIL when VpcBlockPublicAccessOptions.InternetGatewayBlockMode is neither block-bidirectional nor block-ingress.

aws.claude_a.vpc.default_sg_in_use_no_ru.description: Flags a default security group when either ingress or egress rules remain configured on an in-use group. The default group may be inherited by new interfaces, granting unintended network paths.
aws.claude_a.vpc.default_sg_in_use_no_ru.pass_when: PASS when either ingress or egress rules remain configured on an in-use group is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.default_sg_in_use_no_ru.fail_when: FAIL when either ingress or egress rules remain configured on an in-use group.
aws.claude_a.vpc.default_sg_in_use_no_ru.not_applicable_when: The group is not named default. It is also not applicable when the group or VPC has no ENI.

aws.claude_a.vpc.default_sg_no_rules.description: Flags a default security group when either ingress or egress rules remain configured. The default group may be inherited by new interfaces, granting unintended network paths.
aws.claude_a.vpc.default_sg_no_rules.pass_when: PASS when either ingress or egress rules remain configured is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.default_sg_no_rules.fail_when: FAIL when either ingress or egress rules remain configured.
aws.claude_a.vpc.default_sg_no_rules.not_applicable_when: The group is not named default.

aws.claude_a.vpc.endpoint_policy_trust_b.description: For each collected VPC endpoint policy, tests whether every Allow principal names the audited account or is limited by a positive condition on aws:PrincipalAccount or the account field of aws:PrincipalArn. An unconditional foreign or wildcard Allow fails unless a Deny interaction makes the boundary unresolved. Direct principals must use supported identity ARN forms; StringLike PrincipalArn proof requires a literal prefix through the account field, while ArnLike uses ARN component matching. Source or VPC restrictions, unsupported principal or condition shapes, and malformed facts remain UNKNOWN. This tests the declared account boundary, not effective endpoint access.
aws.claude_a.vpc.endpoint_policy_trust_b.pass_when: Every Allow statement has only audited-account AWS principals or a proven positive condition binding its principal account to the audited account, with no unresolved statement.
aws.claude_a.vpc.endpoint_policy_trust_b.fail_when: A collected Allow statement unconditionally names a wildcard or foreign AWS principal and no Deny statement can alter that grant.

aws.claude_a.vpc.endpoint_service_accept.description: Flags an endpoint service owned by the audited account when AcceptanceRequired is false. Other principals allowed by the service can connect without explicit owner approval.
aws.claude_a.vpc.endpoint_service_accept.pass_when: PASS when AcceptanceRequired is false is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.endpoint_service_accept.not_applicable_when: The endpoint service is not owned by the audited account.

aws.claude_a.vpc.endpoint_service_princi.description: Flags an endpoint service owned by the audited account when AllowedPrincipals includes * or a principal from another account. The service can be consumed by untrusted accounts.
aws.claude_a.vpc.endpoint_service_princi.pass_when: PASS when AllowedPrincipals includes * or a principal from another account is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.endpoint_service_princi.fail_when: FAIL when AllowedPrincipals includes * or a principal from another account.
aws.claude_a.vpc.endpoint_service_princi.not_applicable_when: The endpoint service is not owned by the audited account.

aws.claude_a.vpc.flow_logs_active.description: For an owned VPC, fails when no flow log is declared or any associated flow log has FlowLogStatus other than ACTIVE. A mixed ACTIVE and FAILED set fails by pinned source parity; this checks health of every declared log rather than merely existence of one active log.
aws.claude_a.vpc.flow_logs_active.pass_when: The owned VPC has at least one associated flow log and every declared log is ACTIVE.
aws.claude_a.vpc.flow_logs_active.fail_when: The owned VPC has no flow log, or at least one associated log is not ACTIVE.
aws.claude_a.vpc.flow_logs_active.not_applicable_when: The VPC is owned by another account.

aws.claude_a.vpc.gateway_endpoint_policy.description: Flags a gateway VPC endpoint when its policy unconditionally Allows Action * to a wildcard principal. The endpoint policy does not constrain which service operations can traverse the gateway.
aws.claude_a.vpc.gateway_endpoint_policy.pass_when: PASS when its policy unconditionally Allows Action * to a wildcard principal is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.gateway_endpoint_policy.fail_when: FAIL when its policy unconditionally Allows Action * to a wildcard principal.
aws.claude_a.vpc.gateway_endpoint_policy.not_applicable_when: The endpoint is not a Gateway endpoint.

aws.claude_a.vpc.igw_attached.description: Flags an internet gateway when it has zero VPC attachments. An unattached gateway is unused infrastructure and can hide stale network design or later unintended exposure.
aws.claude_a.vpc.igw_attached.pass_when: PASS when it has zero VPC attachments is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.igw_attached.fail_when: FAIL when it has zero VPC attachments.

aws.claude_a.vpc.in_use_subnet_no_auto_p.description: Flags an in-use subnet when MapPublicIpOnLaunch is true. New instances launched into the subnet can receive public IPv4 addresses automatically.
aws.claude_a.vpc.in_use_subnet_no_auto_p.pass_when: PASS when MapPublicIpOnLaunch is true is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.in_use_subnet_no_auto_p.not_applicable_when: The subnet is not in use.

aws.claude_a.vpc.in_use_vpc_ec2_endpoint.description: Flags a VPC when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that in-use VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ec2 service. Clients may need public or NAT routes to reach ec2, increasing exposure and dependency on internet egress.
aws.claude_a.vpc.in_use_vpc_ec2_endpoint.pass_when: PASS when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that in-use VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ec2 service is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.in_use_vpc_ec2_endpoint.fail_when: FAIL when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that in-use VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ec2 service.
aws.claude_a.vpc.in_use_vpc_ec2_endpoint.not_applicable_when: The VPC is not in use.

aws.claude_a.vpc.in_use_vpc_has_flow_log.description: Flags an in-use VPC when no flow_log.ResourceId matches its VpcId. There is no VPC traffic record for incident analysis.
aws.claude_a.vpc.in_use_vpc_has_flow_log.pass_when: PASS when no flow_log.ResourceId matches its VpcId is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.in_use_vpc_has_flow_log.fail_when: FAIL when no flow_log.ResourceId matches its VpcId.
aws.claude_a.vpc.in_use_vpc_has_flow_log.not_applicable_when: The VPC is not in use.

aws.claude_a.vpc.in_use_vpc_public_and_p.description: Flags a VPC when its in-use subnet inventory lacks both public and private subnets under the Prowler route classification. Workloads cannot be separated cleanly between internet-facing and private network tiers.
aws.claude_a.vpc.in_use_vpc_public_and_p.pass_when: PASS when its in-use subnet inventory lacks both public and private subnets under the Prowler route classification is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.in_use_vpc_public_and_p.fail_when: FAIL when its in-use subnet inventory lacks both public and private subnets under the Prowler route classification.
aws.claude_a.vpc.in_use_vpc_public_and_p.not_applicable_when: The VPC is not in use.

aws.claude_a.vpc.in_use_vpc_subnets_mult.description: Flags a VPC when its in-use subnets span at most one distinct AvailabilityZone. A single zone outage can remove all subnet capacity for the VPC.
aws.claude_a.vpc.in_use_vpc_subnets_mult.pass_when: PASS when its in-use subnets span at most one distinct AvailabilityZone is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.in_use_vpc_subnets_mult.fail_when: FAIL when its in-use subnets span at most one distinct AvailabilityZone.
aws.claude_a.vpc.in_use_vpc_subnets_mult.not_applicable_when: The VPC is not in use.

aws.claude_a.vpc.interface_endpoint_ecr_.description: Flags a VPC when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ecr.api service. Clients may need public or NAT routes to reach ecr.api, increasing exposure and dependency on internet egress.
aws.claude_a.vpc.interface_endpoint_ecr_.pass_when: PASS when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ecr.api service is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.interface_endpoint_ecr_.fail_when: FAIL when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ecr.api service.

aws.claude_a.vpc.interface_endpoint_ecr_.description: Flags a VPC when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ecr.dkr service. Clients may need public or NAT routes to reach ecr.dkr, increasing exposure and dependency on internet egress.
aws.claude_a.vpc.interface_endpoint_ecr_.pass_when: PASS when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ecr.dkr service is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.interface_endpoint_ecr_.fail_when: FAIL when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ecr.dkr service.

aws.claude_a.vpc.interface_endpoint_mult.description: Flags an interface VPC endpoint when SubnetIds contains zero or one subnet. A zone failure can interrupt private access to the endpoint service.
aws.claude_a.vpc.interface_endpoint_mult.pass_when: PASS when SubnetIds contains zero or one subnet is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.interface_endpoint_mult.fail_when: FAIL when SubnetIds contains zero or one subnet.
aws.claude_a.vpc.interface_endpoint_mult.not_applicable_when: The endpoint is not Interface type or its VPC is absent from inventory.

aws.claude_a.vpc.interface_endpoint_ssm.description: Flags a VPC when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ssm service. Clients may need public or NAT routes to reach ssm, increasing exposure and dependency on internet egress.
aws.claude_a.vpc.interface_endpoint_ssm.pass_when: PASS when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ssm service is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.interface_endpoint_ssm.fail_when: FAIL when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ssm service.

aws.claude_a.vpc.interface_endpoint_ssm_.description: Flags a VPC when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ssm-contacts service. Clients may need public or NAT routes to reach ssm-contacts, increasing exposure and dependency on internet egress.
aws.claude_a.vpc.interface_endpoint_ssm_.pass_when: PASS when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ssm-contacts service is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.interface_endpoint_ssm_.fail_when: FAIL when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ssm-contacts service.

aws.claude_a.vpc.interface_endpoint_ssm_.description: Flags a VPC when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ssm-incidents service. Clients may need public or NAT routes to reach ssm-incidents, increasing exposure and dependency on internet egress.
aws.claude_a.vpc.interface_endpoint_ssm_.pass_when: PASS when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ssm-incidents service is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.interface_endpoint_ssm_.fail_when: FAIL when no inventoried VPC endpoint in that VPC has ServiceName matching the regional ssm-incidents service.

aws.claude_a.vpc.launch_wizard_sg_not_at.description: Flags a security group named with the launch-wizard prefix when its GroupId appears on a network interface. Wizard-created rules may persist on active workloads after their original purpose ends.
aws.claude_a.vpc.launch_wizard_sg_not_at.pass_when: PASS when its GroupId appears on a network interface is false.
aws.claude_a.vpc.launch_wizard_sg_not_at.fail_when: FAIL when its GroupId appears on a network interface.
aws.claude_a.vpc.launch_wizard_sg_not_at.not_applicable_when: The group name does not start with launch-wizard.

aws.claude_a.vpc.nacl_associated.description: Flags a network ACL when Associations is empty. The ACL is orphaned configuration that can be mistaken for active subnet protection.
aws.claude_a.vpc.nacl_associated.pass_when: PASS when Associations is empty is false.
