aws.gap.iam.root_not_used_90_days.description: Flags the root row of the IAM credential report when a root password or access key was last used within 90 days (calendar-day comparison). Recent root activity may indicate unnecessary privileged use or a compromised root credential.
aws.gap.iam.root_not_used_90_days.pass_when: PASS when a root password or access key was last used within 90 days (calendar-day comparison) is false.
aws.gap.iam.root_not_used_90_days.fail_when: FAIL when a root password or access key was last used within 90 days (calendar-day comparison).
aws.gap.iam.root_not_used_90_days.not_applicable_when: The credential report row is not the root user.

aws.gap.s3.bucket_policy_denies_insecure.description: Checks whether qualifying explicit Deny statements for aws:SecureTransport=false collectively cover the bucket ARN and every object key for wildcard principals and all S3 actions. Coverage may be split across statements; incomplete or malformed policy evidence is UNKNOWN.
aws.gap.s3.bucket_policy_denies_insecure.pass_when: Qualifying Deny statements collectively cover the bucket ARN and the entire bucket/* object namespace; a single literal object key is insufficient.
aws.gap.s3.bucket_policy_denies_insecure.fail_when: The collected bucket policy lacks qualifying Deny coverage for either the bucket or object ARN.

aws.gap.s3.no_public_write_acl_or_policy.description: Flags an S3 bucket when either its ACL or bucket policy permits public write after the evaluator’s public-access-block checks. Anyone may upload, overwrite, or delete objects in the bucket.
aws.gap.s3.no_public_write_acl_or_policy.pass_when: PASS when either its ACL or bucket policy permits public write after the evaluator’s public-access-block checks is false.
aws.gap.s3.no_public_write_acl_or_policy.fail_when: FAIL when either its ACL or bucket policy permits public write after the evaluator’s public-access-block checks.

aws.gap.s3.object_read_events_logged.description: Flags an S3 bucket when no logging multi-Region trail has selectors covering read object data events for this bucket. Read operations on the bucket’s objects may be absent from audit records.
aws.gap.s3.object_read_events_logged.pass_when: PASS when no logging multi-Region trail has selectors covering read object data events for this bucket is false.
aws.gap.s3.object_read_events_logged.fail_when: FAIL when no logging multi-Region trail has selectors covering read object data events for this bucket.

aws.gap.s3.object_read_write_events_logg.description: Flags an S3 bucket when no logging multi-Region trail has selectors covering read and write object data events for this bucket. Read and write operations on the bucket’s objects may be absent from audit records.
aws.gap.s3.object_read_write_events_logg.pass_when: PASS when no logging multi-Region trail has selectors covering read and write object data events for this bucket is false.
aws.gap.s3.object_read_write_events_logg.fail_when: FAIL when no logging multi-Region trail has selectors covering read and write object data events for this bucket.

aws.gap.s3.object_write_events_logged.description: Flags an S3 bucket when no logging multi-Region trail has selectors covering write object data events for this bucket. Write operations on the bucket’s objects may be absent from audit records.
aws.gap.s3.object_write_events_logged.pass_when: PASS when no logging multi-Region trail has selectors covering write object data events for this bucket is false.
aws.gap.s3.object_write_events_logged.fail_when: FAIL when no logging multi-Region trail has selectors covering write object data events for this bucket.

aws.gap.securityhub.region_hub_enabled.description: Flags a Region when no Security Hub hub ARN is present in the regional inventory. Findings from security controls may not be aggregated in that Region.
aws.gap.securityhub.region_hub_enabled.pass_when: PASS when no Security Hub hub ARN is present in the regional inventory is false.
aws.gap.securityhub.region_hub_enabled.fail_when: FAIL when no Security Hub hub ARN is present in the regional inventory.

aws.gap.vpc.sg_world_any_common_ports.description: Flags a security group when an ingress rule from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 covers an evaluator-listed common service port or all traffic. Internet clients can probe administrative and database services on attached workloads.
aws.gap.vpc.sg_world_any_common_ports.pass_when: PASS when an ingress rule from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 covers an evaluator-listed common service port or all traffic is false.
aws.gap.vpc.sg_world_any_common_ports.fail_when: FAIL when an ingress rule from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 covers an evaluator-listed common service port or all traffic.

aws.guardduty.eks_audit_logs.description: Checks an existing GuardDuty detector's Configuration.Status and EKS_AUDIT_LOGS feature Status. Both must be ENABLED; a disabled detector fails even with an enabled feature. Missing or unrecognized required status is UNKNOWN.
aws.guardduty.eks_audit_logs.pass_when: Configuration.Status and the EKS_AUDIT_LOGS feature Status are both ENABLED.
aws.guardduty.eks_audit_logs.fail_when: The detector is DISABLED or the EKS_AUDIT_LOGS feature is absent or DISABLED.

aws.guardduty.lambda_network_logs.description: Checks an existing GuardDuty detector's Configuration.Status and LAMBDA_NETWORK_LOGS feature Status. Both must be ENABLED; a disabled detector fails even with an enabled feature. Missing or unrecognized required status is UNKNOWN.
aws.guardduty.lambda_network_logs.pass_when: Configuration.Status and the LAMBDA_NETWORK_LOGS feature Status are both ENABLED.
aws.guardduty.lambda_network_logs.fail_when: The detector is DISABLED or the LAMBDA_NETWORK_LOGS feature is absent or DISABLED.

aws.guardduty.rds_login_events.description: Checks an existing GuardDuty detector's Configuration.Status and RDS_LOGIN_EVENTS feature Status. Both must be ENABLED; a disabled detector fails even with an enabled feature. Missing or unrecognized required status is UNKNOWN.
aws.guardduty.rds_login_events.pass_when: Configuration.Status and the RDS_LOGIN_EVENTS feature Status are both ENABLED.
aws.guardduty.rds_login_events.fail_when: The detector is DISABLED or the RDS_LOGIN_EVENTS feature is absent or DISABLED.

aws.guardduty.runtime_monitoring.description: Checks an existing GuardDuty detector's Configuration.Status and RUNTIME_MONITORING feature Status. Both must be ENABLED; a disabled detector fails even with an enabled feature. Missing or unrecognized required status is UNKNOWN.
aws.guardduty.runtime_monitoring.pass_when: Configuration.Status and the RUNTIME_MONITORING feature Status are both ENABLED.
aws.guardduty.runtime_monitoring.fail_when: The detector is DISABLED or the RUNTIME_MONITORING feature is absent or DISABLED.

aws.guardduty.s3_data_events.description: Checks an existing GuardDuty detector's Configuration.Status and S3_DATA_EVENTS feature Status. Both must be ENABLED; a disabled detector fails even with an enabled feature. Missing or unrecognized required status is UNKNOWN.
aws.guardduty.s3_data_events.pass_when: Configuration.Status and the S3_DATA_EVENTS feature Status are both ENABLED.
aws.guardduty.s3_data_events.fail_when: The detector is DISABLED or the S3_DATA_EVENTS feature is absent or DISABLED.

aws.htbp.appsync.no_api_key_additional_a.description: Flags an AppSync GraphQL API when additionalAuthenticationProviders contains authenticationType API_KEY. API keys may authorize access to fields bearing @aws_api_key directives.
aws.htbp.appsync.no_api_key_additional_a.pass_when: PASS when additionalAuthenticationProviders contains authenticationType API_KEY is false.
aws.htbp.appsync.no_api_key_additional_a.fail_when: FAIL when additionalAuthenticationProviders contains authenticationType API_KEY.

aws.htbp.cognito.client_no_writable_auth.description: Flags a Cognito user pool when a collected app client can write an authorization-like custom claim (including plan) that is mutable, or an immutable claim during allowed self-service signup. Omitted WriteAttributes is Cognito broad default access when the client detail is complete. Attribute names are a risk heuristic; the application authorization use must be reviewed. Empty explicit write lists remain UNKNOWN because their response semantics are unverified.
aws.htbp.cognito.client_no_writable_auth.pass_when: PASS only with a complete nonempty client inventory and complete schema when every evaluated client has no writable authorization-like custom claim; explicit safe fields such as email remain allowed.
aws.htbp.cognito.client_no_writable_auth.fail_when: FAIL on any definitively writable mutable authorization-like custom claim, including through omitted default WriteAttributes; an immutable such claim also fails when self-service signup is explicitly allowed. Known failures dominate other incomplete client details.
aws.htbp.cognito.client_no_writable_auth.not_applicable_when: A complete empty client inventory is NOT_APPLICABLE. Missing/malformed/denied schema or client detail, incomplete inventory without a definite failure, and an immutable writable claim without resolved signup/federation conditions are UNKNOWN. An explicit empty WriteAttributes list is UNKNOWN until its API semantics are established.

aws.htbp.cognito.identity_pool_classic_f.description: Flags a Cognito identity pool when Configuration.AllowClassicFlow is true. A client can call AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity directly and bypass enhanced-flow credential scope-down.
aws.htbp.cognito.identity_pool_classic_f.pass_when: PASS when Configuration.AllowClassicFlow is true is false.

aws.htbp.ecr.creation_template_policy_tr.description: Flags an ECR registry when a repository creation template policy has an unrestricted Allow to * or a proven account outside the trust boundary. New repositories under the template prefix inherit public or external image access. Organization membership and configured trusted_scope_ids determine whether an external account is trusted; uncollected organization membership yields MANUAL for nonpublic outsiders.
aws.htbp.ecr.creation_template_policy_tr.pass_when: PASS when a repository creation template policy has an unrestricted Allow to * or a proven account outside the trust boundary is false.
aws.htbp.ecr.creation_template_policy_tr.fail_when: FAIL when a repository creation template policy has an unrestricted Allow to * or a proven account outside the trust boundary.

aws.htbp.ecr.registry_policy_trust_bound.description: Flags an ECR registry when RegistryPolicy.policyText has an unrestricted Allow to * or a proven account outside the trust boundary. Outside principals may replicate or access registry images. Organization membership and configured trusted_scope_ids determine whether an external account is trusted; uncollected organization membership yields MANUAL for nonpublic outsiders.
aws.htbp.ecr.registry_policy_trust_bound.pass_when: PASS when RegistryPolicy.policyText has an unrestricted Allow to * or a proven account outside the trust boundary is false.
aws.htbp.ecr.registry_policy_trust_bound.fail_when: FAIL when RegistryPolicy.policyText has an unrestricted Allow to * or a proven account outside the trust boundary.

aws.htbp.ecr.replication_destinations_tr.description: Flags an ECR registry when Replication.rules[].destinations[].registryId names a proven account outside the trust boundary. Matching images are copied into an external registry. Organization membership and configured trusted_scope_ids determine whether an external account is trusted; uncollected organization membership yields MANUAL for nonpublic outsiders.
aws.htbp.ecr.replication_destinations_tr.pass_when: PASS when Replication.rules[].destinations[].registryId names a proven account outside the trust boundary is false.
aws.htbp.ecr.replication_destinations_tr.fail_when: FAIL when Replication.rules[].destinations[].registryId names a proven account outside the trust boundary.

aws.htbp.ecs.exec_session_logging_not_di.description: Flags an ECS cluster when Configuration.clusters[0].configuration.executeCommandConfiguration.logging equals NONE. Interactive ECS Exec commands may have no retained session transcript; DEFAULT is accepted even though task log configuration is separate.
aws.htbp.ecs.exec_session_logging_not_di.pass_when: PASS when Configuration.clusters[0].configuration.executeCommandConfiguration.logging equals NONE is false.

aws.htbp.ecs.no_sensitive_host_mounts.description: Flags an ECS task definition when a container mountPoints.sourceVolume references a host volume whose sourcePath is /, a Docker/containerd socket, or another listed sensitive host path. Container code may read host files or control the runtime, potentially gaining host-level access.
aws.htbp.ecs.no_sensitive_host_mounts.pass_when: PASS when a container mountPoints.sourceVolume references a host volume whose sourcePath is /, a Docker/containerd socket, or another listed sensitive host path is false.
aws.htbp.ecs.no_sensitive_host_mounts.fail_when: FAIL when a container mountPoints.sourceVolume references a host volume whose sourcePath is /, a Docker/containerd socket, or another listed sensitive host path.

aws.htbp.eks.access_entries_authenticati.description: Flags an EKS cluster when Cluster.cluster.accessConfig.authenticationMode equals CONFIG_MAP. The cluster creator can retain hidden system:masters access through legacy authentication.
aws.htbp.eks.access_entries_authenticati.pass_when: PASS when authenticationMode is API; API_AND_CONFIG_MAP returns MANUAL because legacy mappings remain.

aws.htbp.eks.access_entry_principal_trus.description: Flags an EKS access entry when principalArn belongs to a proven account outside the trust boundary. An outsider IAM principal could authenticate to the cluster using the access entry. Organization membership and configured trusted_scope_ids determine whether an external account is trusted; uncollected organization membership yields MANUAL for nonpublic outsiders.
aws.htbp.eks.access_entry_principal_trus.pass_when: PASS when principalArn belongs to a proven account outside the trust boundary is false.
aws.htbp.eks.access_entry_principal_trus.fail_when: FAIL when principalArn belongs to a proven account outside the trust boundary.

aws.htbp.glue.dev_endpoint_not_public.description: Flags a Glue development endpoint when PublicAddress is nonempty. A reachable SSH endpoint can be taken over by someone able to add an SSH public key through Glue.
aws.htbp.glue.dev_endpoint_not_public.pass_when: PASS when PublicAddress is nonempty is false.

aws.htbp.kms.grant_grantee_trust_boundar.description: Flags a KMS grant when GranteePrincipal is an IAM account or ARN from a proven account outside the trust boundary. The grantee can perform granted cryptographic operations until the grant is retired or revoked. Organization membership and configured trusted_scope_ids determine whether an external account is trusted; uncollected organization membership yields MANUAL for nonpublic outsiders.
aws.htbp.kms.grant_grantee_trust_boundar.pass_when: PASS when the grantee is a service principal or an account within the trust boundary.
aws.htbp.kms.grant_grantee_trust_boundar.fail_when: FAIL when GranteePrincipal is an IAM account or ARN from a proven account outside the trust boundary.

aws.htbp.lambda.env_var_names_not_creden.description: Flags a Lambda function when EnvironmentVariableNames.names includes a name matching SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, PASSWORD, PASSWD, PRIVATE_KEY, or CLIENT_SECRET without a reference suffix. Configuration readers may obtain literal credentials if the matching variable holds one; only names are collected.
aws.htbp.lambda.env_var_names_not_creden.pass_when: PASS when EnvironmentVariableNames.names includes a name matching SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, PASSWORD, PASSWD, PRIVATE_KEY, or CLIENT_SECRET without a reference suffix is false.
aws.htbp.lambda.env_var_names_not_creden.fail_when: FAIL when EnvironmentVariableNames.names includes a name matching SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, PASSWORD, PASSWD, PRIVATE_KEY, or CLIENT_SECRET without a reference suffix.

aws.htbp.lambda.layer_version_trust_boun.description: Flags a Lambda layer version when Policy.Policy has an unrestricted Allow to * or a proven account outside the trust boundary. Outside principals can download the layer code and any bundled secrets. Organization membership and configured trusted_scope_ids determine whether an external account is trusted; uncollected organization membership yields MANUAL for nonpublic outsiders.
aws.htbp.lambda.layer_version_trust_boun.pass_when: PASS when Policy.Policy has an unrestricted Allow to * or a proven account outside the trust boundary is false.
aws.htbp.lambda.layer_version_trust_boun.fail_when: FAIL when Policy.Policy has an unrestricted Allow to * or a proven account outside the trust boundary.

aws.htbp.lambda.runtime_updates_not_pinn.description: Flags a Lambda function when RuntimeManagement.UpdateRuntimeOn equals Manual. A runtime version can stay pinned after security fixes become available.
aws.htbp.lambda.runtime_updates_not_pinn.pass_when: PASS when RuntimeManagement.UpdateRuntimeOn equals Manual is false.
aws.htbp.lambda.runtime_updates_not_pinn.not_applicable_when: RuntimeManagement is explicitly absent, such as for a container-image function.

aws.htbp.opensearch.connection_peer_trus.description: Flags a live OpenSearch cross-cluster connection when the remote peer for outbound or local peer for inbound has AWSDomainInformation.OwnerId in a proven outside account. Queries or indexed data can cross into an untrusted account. Organization membership and configured trusted_scope_ids determine whether an external account is trusted; uncollected organization membership yields MANUAL for nonpublic outsiders.
aws.htbp.opensearch.connection_peer_trus.pass_when: PASS when the remote peer for outbound or local peer for inbound has AWSDomainInformation.OwnerId in a proven outside account is false.
aws.htbp.opensearch.connection_peer_trus.fail_when: FAIL when the remote peer for outbound or local peer for inbound has AWSDomainInformation.OwnerId in a proven outside account.
aws.htbp.opensearch.connection_peer_trus.not_applicable_when: StatusCode is validation failed, rejecting, rejected, deleting, or deleted.

aws.htbp.sagemaker.notebook_imdsv2_requi.description: Flags a SageMaker notebook instance when InstanceMetadataServiceConfiguration.MinimumInstanceMetadataServiceVersion equals 1. Tokenless IMDSv1 requests from notebook code or SSRF may expose execution-role credentials.

aws.iam.access_key_count.description: Flags an IAM user when more than one AccessKeys.items row has Status Active. Extra live long-lived credentials expand the set of secrets that can be stolen.
aws.iam.access_key_count.pass_when: PASS when more than one AccessKeys.items row has Status Active is false.
aws.iam.access_key_count.fail_when: FAIL when more than one AccessKeys.items row has Status Active.

aws.iam.console_mfa.description: Flags an IAM user with a LoginProfile when MFADevices is empty. A stolen console password alone can access the user account.
aws.iam.console_mfa.pass_when: PASS when MFADevices is empty is false.
aws.iam.console_mfa.not_applicable_when: The user has no console LoginProfile.

aws.iam.no_full_admin.description: Flags an IAM policy when an unconditional Allow statement combines Action * and Resource *. The policy grants unrestricted administrative API access.
aws.iam.no_full_admin.pass_when: PASS when an unconditional Allow statement combines Action * and Resource * is false.
aws.iam.no_full_admin.fail_when: FAIL for an unconditional Allow Action * on Resource *; conditional wildcard grants return MANUAL.

aws.iam.no_root_keys.description: Flags an iam account summary when SummaryMap.AccountAccessKeysPresent is 1 rather than 0. A root access key provides long-lived unrestricted account credentials.

aws.iam.password_lowercase.description: Flags an iam password policy when PasswordPolicy.RequireLowercaseCharacters is false rather than true. A weaker character policy increases the usefulness of password guessing.

aws.iam.password_max_age.description: Flags the IAM account password policy when PasswordPolicy.MaxPasswordAge is 0 or above 90. Old passwords can stay valid after disclosure.
aws.iam.password_max_age.pass_when: PASS when MaxPasswordAge is between 1 and 90.
aws.iam.password_max_age.fail_when: FAIL when PasswordPolicy.MaxPasswordAge is 0 or above 90.

aws.iam.password_minimum_length.description: Flags the IAM account password policy when PasswordPolicy.MinimumPasswordLength is below 14. Short passwords are easier to brute-force or guess.
aws.iam.password_minimum_length.pass_when: PASS when MinimumPasswordLength is at least 14.

aws.iam.password_numbers.description: Flags an iam password policy when PasswordPolicy.RequireNumbers is false rather than true. A weaker character policy increases the usefulness of password guessing.

aws.iam.password_reuse_prevention.description: Flags the IAM account password policy when PasswordPolicy.PasswordReusePrevention is not 24. Previously compromised passwords can be reused sooner.

aws.iam.password_symbols.description: Flags an iam password policy when PasswordPolicy.RequireSymbols is false rather than true. A weaker character policy increases the usefulness of password guessing.

aws.iam.password_uppercase.description: Flags an iam password policy when PasswordPolicy.RequireUppercaseCharacters is false rather than true. A weaker character policy increases the usefulness of password guessing.

aws.iam.restrict_public_trust.description: Flags an IAM role when AssumeRolePolicyDocument contains an unconditional Allow statement with a wildcard principal. Any principal matched by the trust policy may be able to assume the role.
aws.iam.restrict_public_trust.pass_when: PASS when AssumeRolePolicyDocument contains an unconditional Allow statement with a wildcard principal is false.
aws.iam.restrict_public_trust.fail_when: FAIL for unconditional wildcard-principal Allow statements; conditioned wildcard statements alone return MANUAL.

aws.iam.root_mfa.description: Flags the root row of an IAM credential report when a root password or either access key is active and mfa_active is false. A stolen root credential can control the whole account without a second factor.
aws.iam.root_mfa.pass_when: PASS when a root password or either access key is active and mfa_active is false is false.
aws.iam.root_mfa.fail_when: FAIL when a root password or either access key is active and mfa_active is false.
aws.iam.root_mfa.not_applicable_when: The row is not root, or root has no active password or access key.

aws.kms.no_pending_key_deletion.description: Flags a KMS key when Metadata.KeyMetadata.KeyState is PendingDeletion. When deletion completes, ciphertext protected by the key becomes unrecoverable.
aws.kms.no_pending_key_deletion.pass_when: PASS when Metadata.KeyMetadata.KeyState is PendingDeletion is false.
aws.kms.no_pending_key_deletion.not_applicable_when: KeyManager is AWS or KeyState is Disabled.

aws.kms.rotation.description: Flags a customer managed symmetric AWS_KMS-origin key when Rotation.KeyRotationEnabled is false. Long-lived key material increases the impact of key compromise.
aws.kms.rotation.pass_when: PASS when Rotation.KeyRotationEnabled is false is false.
aws.kms.rotation.not_applicable_when: The key is AWS-managed, external-origin, or not SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT.

aws.lambda.dead_letter_queue.description: Flags a Lambda function when DeadLetterConfig has no nonempty TargetArn. Asynchronous invocation failures may be lost without a durable failure destination.
aws.lambda.dead_letter_queue.pass_when: PASS when DeadLetterConfig has no nonempty TargetArn is false.
aws.lambda.dead_letter_queue.fail_when: FAIL when DeadLetterConfig has no nonempty TargetArn.

aws.lambda.function_url_authentication.description: Flags a Lambda function with a URL when FunctionUrl.AuthType is NONE. The URL itself accepts unauthenticated requests; resource permissions are evaluated separately.
aws.lambda.function_url_authentication.pass_when: PASS when FunctionUrl.AuthType is NONE is false.

aws.lambda.vpc_configuration.description: Flags a lambda function when VpcConfig.VpcId is empty. The function cannot use the intended private VPC resources or egress controls.
aws.lambda.vpc_configuration.pass_when: PASS when VpcConfig.VpcId is empty is false.

aws.logs.retention.description: Flags a CloudWatch log group when retentionInDays is omitted. Logs never expire automatically, increasing storage cost and retained sensitive data.
aws.logs.retention.pass_when: PASS when retentionInDays is omitted is false.

aws.rds.auto_minor_upgrade.description: Flags an rds instance when AutoMinorVersionUpgrade is false rather than true. Known engine defects may remain unpatched on the database instance.

aws.rds.backups.description: Flags a non-replica RDS instance when BackupRetentionPeriod is zero. There is no automated recovery window after accidental deletion or corruption.
aws.rds.backups.pass_when: PASS when BackupRetentionPeriod is zero is false.
aws.rds.backups.not_applicable_when: The instance is a read replica.

aws.rds.cloudwatch_log_exports.description: Flags an RDS instance when EnabledCloudwatchLogsExports is an empty list. Database engine logs may be unavailable for detection and investigation.
aws.rds.cloudwatch_log_exports.pass_when: PASS when EnabledCloudwatchLogsExports is an empty list is false.
aws.rds.cloudwatch_log_exports.fail_when: FAIL when EnabledCloudwatchLogsExports is an empty list.

aws.rds.cluster_copy_snapshot_tags.description: Flags an rds cluster when CopyTagsToSnapshot is false rather than true. Snapshots may lose classification or ownership tags needed for access and inventory controls.

aws.rds.cluster_deletion_protection.description: Flags an rds cluster when DeletionProtection is false rather than true. A mistaken or malicious DeleteDBCluster call can remove the database.

aws.rds.cluster_encryption.description: Flags an rds cluster when StorageEncrypted is false rather than true. Stored cluster data and snapshots may lack the configured at-rest protection.

aws.rds.cluster_iam_authentication.description: Flags an rds cluster when IAMDatabaseAuthenticationEnabled is false rather than true. Database clients may rely only on long-lived database passwords.

aws.rds.cluster_multi_az.description: Flags an rds cluster when MultiAZ is false rather than true. A single Availability Zone failure may interrupt the cluster.

aws.rds.copy_snapshot_tags.description: Flags a non-Aurora RDS instance when CopyTagsToSnapshot is false. Created snapshots may lose ownership or classification tags.
aws.rds.copy_snapshot_tags.pass_when: PASS when CopyTagsToSnapshot is false is false.
aws.rds.copy_snapshot_tags.not_applicable_when: Engine is aurora, aurora-mysql, or aurora-postgresql.

aws.rds.deletion_protection.description: Flags an rds instance when DeletionProtection is false rather than true. A mistaken or malicious DeleteDBInstance call can remove the database.

aws.rds.encryption.description: Flags an rds instance when StorageEncrypted is false rather than true. Stored instance data and snapshots may lack the configured at-rest protection.

aws.rds.enhanced_monitoring.description: Flags a rds instance when EnhancedMonitoringResourceArn is empty. OS-level metrics may be unavailable when diagnosing suspicious database activity.
aws.rds.enhanced_monitoring.pass_when: PASS when EnhancedMonitoringResourceArn is empty is false.

aws.rds.no_public_endpoint.description: Flags an RDS instance when PubliclyAccessible is true. The database endpoint can receive public addressing, increasing exposure if network rules permit access.
aws.rds.no_public_endpoint.pass_when: PASS when PubliclyAccessible is true is false.

aws.rds.snapshot_encryption.description: Flags an rds snapshot when Encrypted is false rather than true. A shared or copied snapshot may expose database data without at-rest encryption.

aws.rds.vpc_configuration.description: Flags a rds instance when DBSubnetGroup.VpcId is empty. The database may lack the intended VPC network isolation.
aws.rds.vpc_configuration.pass_when: PASS when DBSubnetGroup.VpcId is empty is false.

aws.s3.access_logging.description: Flags an S3 bucket when Logging.LoggingEnabled is absent. Server access records may be unavailable to investigate requests to the bucket.
aws.s3.access_logging.pass_when: PASS when Logging.LoggingEnabled is absent is false.

aws.s3.default_encryption.description: The bucket evaluator reads Encryption.ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration.Rules and accepts only AES256, aws:kms, or aws:kms:dsse algorithms. It never emits FAIL: missing or unrecognized encryption evidence becomes UNKNOWN, so this check cannot establish whether new objects lack default encryption.
aws.s3.default_encryption.pass_when: PASS when collected rules contain a recognized encryption algorithm.
aws.s3.default_encryption.fail_when: Never FAIL; missing, absent, or unrecognized rule data returns UNKNOWN.

aws.s3.no_public_acl.description: The bucket ACL evaluator searches Grantee.URI for the AllUsers or AuthenticatedUsers global groups. Such grants can expose objects, but the check returns MANUAL because account and bucket IgnorePublicAcls and Object Ownership determine whether they are effective.
aws.s3.no_public_acl.pass_when: PASS when neither public group URI appears in the ACL.
aws.s3.no_public_acl.fail_when: Never FAIL; a public ACL grant returns MANUAL for effective-access review.

aws.s3.public_access_block.description: Flags an S3 bucket when at least one of the four public-access-block flags is false at both bucket and account levels. A public ACL or policy may be admitted when its corresponding block is disabled.
aws.s3.public_access_block.pass_when: PASS when at least one of the four public-access-block flags is false at both bucket and account levels is false.
aws.s3.public_access_block.fail_when: FAIL when at least one of the four public-access-block flags is false at both bucket and account levels.

aws.s3.versioning.description: Flags an S3 bucket when Versioning.Status is Suspended or absent. Overwritten or deleted objects may not have recoverable prior versions.
aws.s3.versioning.pass_when: PASS when Versioning.Status is Suspended or absent is false.
aws.s3.versioning.fail_when: FAIL when Versioning.Status is Suspended or absent.

aws.secretsmanager.rotation.description: Flags an secret when RotationEnabled is false rather than true. A leaked secret can remain usable until someone rotates it manually.

aws.sns.kms_encryption.description: Flags a sns topic when Attributes.Attributes.KmsMasterKeyId is empty. Messages in the topic may lack the selected KMS key protection.
aws.sns.kms_encryption.pass_when: PASS when Attributes.Attributes.KmsMasterKeyId is empty is false.

aws.sqs.encryption.description: Flags an SQS queue when SqsManagedSseEnabled is false and KmsMasterKeyId is empty. Queued message bodies may lack at-rest encryption.
aws.sqs.encryption.pass_when: PASS when SQS-managed SSE is true or a KMS master key ID is present.
aws.sqs.encryption.fail_when: FAIL when SqsManagedSseEnabled is false and KmsMasterKeyId is empty.
